title: GitHub - macOS virtual environment maintenance
text:
Service: GitHub
Maintenance: macOS virtual environment maintenance
Status: completed
Impact: maintenance
Scheduled for: 2020-12-15T10:00:00.000Z
Scheduled until: 2020-12-19T04:00:00.000Z
Updates:
- 2020-12-18T19:01:59.096Z: completed - The scheduled maintenance has been completed.
- 2020-12-15T10:00:40.056Z: in_progress - Scheduled maintenance is currently in progress. We will provide updates as necessary.
- 2020-12-15T09:00:29.617Z: scheduled - Maintenance will begin as scheduled in 60 minutes.
- 2020-12-14T16:37:35.959Z: scheduled - During the week of December 14-18, GitHub will be performing scheduled maintenance on one of our datacenters that may result in longer than normal queue times for macOS workflows using macos-latest, macos-10.14, or macos-10.15. In some cases, it may be possible that jobs will time out or be cancelled, and will need to be restarted.

We apologize for the inconvenience and encourage you to be patient, and give your workflows extra time to run. Follow our progress in the virtual-environments repo here .
